rationale: The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (evidence: experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200, 20.4% elapsed savings) supports caching dependency downloads to reduce CI time. The proj-ubuntu job runs a large matrix (2 Rust versions x 8 feature combinations) inside containers and repeatedly fetches crates from the cargo registry without any cargo cache. Adding an actions/cache step for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git, keyed on the Cargo.lock hash, reuses dependency downloads across matrix cells and reruns while preserving all build and test steps unchanged. The cargo registry is content-addressed and immutable, so there is no mutable or untrusted cached content, and no equivalent cargo cache exists in this job. The existing vcpkg cache in proj-windows-msvc-vcpkg confirms actions/cache is already used safely in this workflow.
